dataset_name: ICIA Golden Evaluation Set - Standard Agreement v2
description: Expanded contract retrieval set. One canonical contract is available; legal-scope cases identify the seeded legal corpus but do not assert a legal result.

cases.question: Which party is described as the Government in the employee agreement?
cases.expected_answer: The Governor of Goa is described as the Government.

cases.question: Who is the other party to the employee agreement?
cases.expected_answer: The other party is the named Shri/Smt./Kum. identified in the agreement as the Official.

expected_evidence.anchor: hereinafter referred to as the â€œOfficialâ€

cases.question: For what type of appointment is the employee agreement used?
cases.expected_answer: It is used for appointment to a post on contract basis.

cases.question: What event starts the employee's appointment period?
cases.expected_answer: The stated period runs from the date the official takes charge of the post.

expected_evidence.anchor: with effect from the date the official takes charge

cases.question: What document is said to govern the terms and conditions of the appointment?
cases.expected_answer: The agreement specifies the terms and conditions governing the appointment.

expected_evidence.anchor: governed by an Agreement specifying the terms and conditions

cases.question: Does the employee have to follow the Government's orders?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The Official must submit to the Government's orders and observe the rules and regulations in force.

expected_evidence.anchor: submit himself to the orders of the Government

cases.question: Can the Official be assigned duties from time to time?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The Official must carry out duties assigned from time to time.

expected_evidence.anchor: carry out the duties as assigned to him from time to time

cases.question: What standard of performance does the agreement require from the Official?
cases.expected_answer: The Official must work efficiently and diligently to the best of their ability.

expected_evidence.anchor: employ himself/ herself efficiently and diligently

cases.question: What must the contractor do strictly according to the tender?
expected_concepts: carry out the said work strictly
cases.expected_answer: The contractor must carry out the work strictly according to the Tender provisions.

expected_evidence.anchor: carry out the said work strictly

cases.question: When must the contractor commence the work?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor must commence on the date specified in the applicable tender or work order; the form does not fill in that date.

cases.question: Within what period must the contractor complete the work?
cases.expected_answer: Completion is required within the time period indicated in the tender.

cases.question: What security must the contractor provide when required by the work order?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor must provide the performance security required by the work order.

cases.question: Are the tender, work order, and financial bid incorporated into the agreement?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The identified tender, work order, and financial bid documents form part of the agreement as stated.

cases.question: Must the Official obtain permission before an ordinary absence?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The Official must obtain prior permission from the Head of the Department, subject to the stated accident or sickness exception.

expected_evidence.anchor: absent himself/herself from his/ her duties without obtaining prior permission

cases.question: Is the Official required to devote all working time to assigned duties?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The Official must devote their whole time to the assigned duties.

cases.question: How is the employee's monthly salary described?
cases.expected_answer: It is described as a consolidated monthly salary, but the amount remains a blank placeholder in this standard form.

cases.question: Who is to pay the consolidated monthly salary?
cases.expected_answer: The Government is to pay the consolidated monthly salary to the Official.

expected_evidence.anchor: The Government shall pay to the Official

cases.question: What condition is attached to payment under clause 7?
cases.expected_answer: Payment is stated to continue while the Official remains in office and actually performs the duties.

cases.question: When may the Official draw TA/DA?
cases.expected_answer: The Official may draw TA/DA as admissible to similarly placed Government officials when required to go outside headquarters on official duties.

cases.question: What happens to CPF eligibility if the contract extends beyond one year?
cases.expected_answer: On such an extension, the Official may contribute to CPF as applicable, with the stated Government contribution and interest payable at the end of the agreement or extension.

expected_evidence.anchor: period of contract is extended beyond one year

cases.question: Who bears the stamp duty payable on the agreement?
cases.expected_answer: The Government bears the stamp duty payable on the agreement.

cases.question: Can the Official terminate at any time under clause 5?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, subject to giving one calendar month's notice in writing to the Government.

expected_evidence.anchor: The Official may terminate this Agreement

cases.question: What is the form of notice required for the Official's termination?
cases.expected_answer: The notice must be given in writing to the Government.

cases.question: When does the agreement terminate after the Official gives notice?
cases.expected_answer: It stands terminated on expiry of the notice.

expected_evidence.anchor: on the expiry of such notice

cases.question: What advance notice must the Government give the Official to terminate?
cases.expected_answer: The Government must give the Official one month's advance notice in writing.

expected_evidence.anchor: The Government may terminate this Agreement

cases.question: What payment is due if the Government gives no termination notice?
cases.expected_answer: The Government must refund an amount equivalent to one month's pay in lieu of notice.

expected_evidence.anchor: pay of one month in lieu

cases.question: Does the employee termination clause state an immediate termination right without notice?
cases.expected_answer: No. The clause states a one-calendar-month written notice requirement.

cases.question: Does the agreement specify an automatic renewal mechanism?
cases.expected_answer: No automatic renewal mechanism is stated in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Does the agreement state a renewal notice window?
cases.expected_answer: No renewal notice window is stated in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Is extension beyond one year mentioned for CPF purposes?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, extension beyond one year is mentioned as the condition for the stated CPF treatment; it is not an automatic renewal clause.

cases.question: What exception permits absence without prior permission?
cases.expected_answer: The stated exception is accident or sickness certified by the competent medical authority.

expected_evidence.anchor: case of accident or sickness certified

cases.question: What happens to salary for absence beyond admissible leave?
cases.expected_answer: The agreement provides for a proportionate reduction in admissible salary under the stated conditions.

cases.question: Does the agreement contain an indemnity obligation?
cases.expected_answer: No indemnity obligation is identified in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Does the agreement cap either party's liability?
cases.expected_answer: No liability cap is stated in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Does the agreement include a confidentiality survival period?
cases.expected_answer: No confidentiality survival period is stated in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Does the agreement assign intellectual property rights?
cases.expected_answer: No intellectual-property assignment provision is identified in the provided agreement.

cases.question: Which document comes immediately after the Agreement in the precedence list?
cases.expected_answer: The Work order comes immediately after the Agreement.

cases.question: Which document follows the Work order in the precedence list?
cases.expected_answer: The Financial bid follows the Work order.

cases.question: Who appoints the sole arbitrator under the employee agreement?
cases.expected_answer: The sole arbitrator is a person appointed by the specified Secretary to the Government of Goa.

cases.question: Are arbitration awards described as binding on the parties?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The award is stated to be final and binding on the parties.

expected_evidence.anchor: final and binding on the parties

cases.question: Which statute is stated to apply to the arbitration proceedings?
cases.expected_answer: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and rules framed under it are stated to apply.

cases.question: What contractual risk follows from the blank salary fields?
cases.expected_answer: A product risk is that the exact salary cannot be determined from this unfilled standard form; that is a document-completeness observation, not a legal conclusion.

cases.question: What operational risk is associated with the no-work-no-wages clause?
cases.expected_answer: The clause creates a potential pay-impact risk for absence beyond admissible leave, subject to its stated conditions.

cases.question: What should an answer avoid claiming about the employee's regular service status?
cases.expected_answer: It should report the contract's express no-claim wording without presenting that contract text alone as a universal legal conclusion.

expected_evidence.anchor: right or claim to be appointed in the regular service

cases.question: What document-completeness risk appears in the appointment form?
cases.expected_answer: Several identifying, appointment, period, and salary fields remain placeholders, so the executed particulars cannot be inferred from this template.

cases.question: What exact designation was assigned to the Official?
cases.expected_answer: The exact designation cannot be determined because the designation field is a placeholder.

cases.question: What is the exact contract duration in this form?
cases.expected_answer: The exact duration cannot be determined because the period field is blank.

cases.question: What is the name of the appointing department?
cases.expected_answer: The department name cannot be determined because the form contains a blank department or organisation field.

cases.question: What date was the agreement signed?
cases.expected_answer: The exact signing date cannot be determined from the unfilled date fields and signature form.

cases.question: Does this contract wording by itself establish the legal enforceability of the regular-service exclusion?
cases.expected_answer: No. The contract states the exclusion, but enforceability requires appropriate legal authority from the identified corpus and must not be inferred from the contract alone.

expected_evidence.anchor: shall not bestow on the Official any right or claim

cases.provenance: Contract page 4 plus seeded legal corpus reference

cases.expected_answer: No. The agreement supplies contract evidence, while a conclusion under Indian law requires retrieved legal authority.

cases.expected_answer: No. The system should state that legal evidence is unavailable or insufficient rather than claim a current legal conclusion.
cases.provenance: Contract page 4 plus seeded legal corpus reference

cases.question: Separate the contract's notice rule from any legal rule about termination notice.
cases.expected_answer: The contract states a one-calendar-month written notice rule for the Official; any broader legal rule requires separate legal evidence.
cases.provenance: Contract page 4 plus seeded legal corpus reference

cases.question: What is the contract fact about arbitration, and what cannot be concluded about validity from it alone?
cases.expected_answer: The contract provides for sole arbitration and names the applicable arbitration statute; validity or legal effect beyond that text requires legal authority.
cases.provenance: Contract page 5 plus seeded legal corpus reference

cases.question: Which clause supports the statement that contract appointment does not create regular-service entitlement?
cases.expected_answer: Clause (2), on page 4, states that contract appointment does not bestow a right or claim to regular Government service.
